chapters_select_entitled.name: chapters_select_entitled
chapters_select_entitled.using: exists (select 1 from lessons l where l.chapter_id = "chapters"."id")

content_versions_select_entitled.name: content_versions_select_entitled
content_versions_select_entitled.using:
exists (
        select 1 from entitlements en
        where en.content_version_id = "content_versions"."id" and en.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      )

editions_select_entitled.name: editions_select_entitled
editions_select_entitled.using: exists (select 1 from subjects s where s.edition_id = "editions"."id")

glossary_terms_select_entitled.name: glossary_terms_select_entitled
glossary_terms_select_entitled.using: exists (select 1 from subjects s where s.id = "glossary_terms"."subject_id")

lesson_feeds_select_entitled.name: lesson_feeds_select_entitled
lesson_feeds_select_entitled.using:
not exists (
        select 1 from unnest("lesson_feeds"."source_version_ids") as v(id)
        where not exists (
          select 1 from entitlements en
          where en.content_version_id = v.id and en.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        )
      )

lesson_parts_select_entitled.name: lesson_parts_select_entitled
lesson_parts_select_entitled.using:
exists (
        select 1 from entitlements en
        where en.lesson_part_id = "lesson_parts"."id" and en.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      )

lesson_parts_video_id_check.name: lesson_parts_video_id_check
lesson_parts_video_id_check.value: video_id is null or (kind = 'video' and video_id ~ '^[0-9]{1,20}$')

lessons_select_entitled.name: lessons_select_entitled
lessons_select_entitled.using: exists (select 1 from lesson_parts p where p.lesson_id = "lessons"."id")

study_programs_select_entitled.name: study_programs_select_entitled
study_programs_select_entitled.using: exists (select 1 from editions e where e.study_program_id = "study_programs"."id")

subjects_select_entitled.name: subjects_select_entitled
subjects_select_entitled.using: exists (select 1 from chapters c where c.subject_id = "subjects"."id")

subtitle_tracks_select_entitled.name: subtitle_tracks_select_entitled
subtitle_tracks_select_entitled.using:
exists (
        select 1 from subtitle_access sa
        where sa.subtitle_track_id = "subtitle_tracks"."id" and sa.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      )
